map.语音转文字是做什么的？: What does Speech to Text do?
map.如何使用语音转文字？: How do I use Speech to Text?
map.语音转文字适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Speech to Text best for?
map.基于 Transformers.js 在浏览器本地运行 Whisper 模型，将: Runs the Whisper model locally in the browser via Transformers.js to convert audio into text, with no data upload.
map.本工具在浏览器本地解码音频并加载 Whisper 模型转写文字，支持 mp3 /: This tool decodes audio locally in the browser and loads the Whisper model to transcribe text, supporting mp3 / wav / m4a and more, with no upload at any stage.
map.在浏览器本地用 Web Speech API 将麦克风录音实时识别为中文文本。: Uses the Web Speech API in the browser to recognize microphone audio into Chinese text in real time.
map.纯前端、不上传音频，保护隐私；适合会议纪要、字幕与速记。: Pure front-end, no audio upload, privacy-preserving; suited to meeting notes, subtitles and transcription.
map.识别受口音、噪声与网络语音引擎可用性影响，长段需分段校对。: Recognition is affected by accent, noise and the availability of the network speech engine; long passages need segment-by-segment proofreading.
map.点击录音后口述'明天上午十点开会'，工具实时返回'明天上午十点开会'。环境嘈杂或: After clicking record and saying 'Meeting at 10am tomorrow', the tool returns 'Meeting at 10am tomorrow' in real time. In noisy environments or with proper nouns it may misrecognize, so verify key points manually.
map.为什么有时识别不了？: Why does it sometimes fail to recognize?
map.Web Speech API 在部分浏览器/环境需联网调用系统语音引擎，离线或无: The Web Speech API needs to call the system speech engine online in some browsers/environments and fails offline or without permission; heavy accents and loud noise also lower accuracy.
map.本工具在浏览器内处理、不上传；但是否真正本地取决于浏览器实现，部分引擎仍会调用云: This tool processes inside the browser with no upload; but whether it is truly local depends on the browser implementation, and some engines still call cloud recognition services, so confirm before handling sensitive content.
